dct_description_sm: Eritrea administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 2 levels: - Admin 1: 6 Zoba - Admin 2: 58 Sub-Zoba Dates associated with this dataset: - 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 27 April 2020: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 29 April 2020: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 29 April 2020: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rosea). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
